description: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida State Rep. Berny Jacques warned Tuesday that he believes Democrats are attempting to “import the third world” to dilute American votes, while touting a key endorsement from U.S. Rep. Anna Paulina Luna and praising state leadership under Gov. Ron DeSantis.
title: Rep. Berny Jacques says Democrats seek to ‘import the third world,’ touts Luna endorsement and DeSantis record » Berny Jacques for State Representative | Berny Jacques for State Representative
